title: Causal Estimation from Linked Records with Unknown Vanishing Linkage Correctness and Audits
banked_reason: Stage 0.5 (typed) BELOW NOVELTY FLOOR: tier=incremental < floor=field and NOT salvageable in scope; math and four cited checks pass; positive-audit sharp decision surfaces remain unresolved.
proof_attempt_summary: through reviewed D0 graph updates and certificate construction. The final mathematical panel and all four cited-source checks passed, but the general review graded the achieved contribution incremental against the field floor (score ceiling 6.1 versus 7.4). Sharp positive-audit risk and honest-length surfaces, least-favourable density contacts, and decision relevance of orthogonal density-shape information remain unresolved; F1–F5 and Lean formalization were not entered.
tldr: Unknown vanishing correctness creates a causal scale ambiguity that a large linked file cannot remove uniformly. Over a correctness-only rowwise linkage class containing nonsymmetric binary outcomes and smooth continuous clean outcome distributions, the proposed frontier gives minimax squared risk of order \((1+a_nr_n)^{-1}\) and ninety-percent honest connected length of order \((1+a_nr_n)^{-1/2}\), even when released-pair information diverges. At finite signal and audit budgets the full experiment retains an outcome-density Gaussian signal and genuine-outcome Poisson marks. An information-rank and deficiency theorem separates it from finite-parameter audit games. A source-faithful Slawski audit PS plug-in has strictly improvable worst risk at a positive critical intensity. The first-class open question is the sharp causal least-favourable density-shape and audit-value surface conditional on the public donor design; the continuous-design frontier must be evaluated separately from the binary worst case; binary one-mark and initial-slope formulas are calibration corollaries. The contribution targets a field-level correctness-validation frontier.
gap: Fixed-law linkage estimating equations do not give a uniform answer to whether more released records can overcome an unknown correctness scale. Generic Gaussian and marked-Poisson decision programs do not characterize nonparametric clean outcome shapes or their least-favourable causal laws.
fill: Derive the all-procedure audit-driven rate and honesty frontier, prove a full density-signal limit and a formal separation from finite-parameter games, and determine sharp least-favourable causal uncertainty surfaces. Compare directly with the published audit PS plug-in. Rational certification, two-way transfer and attainment support these claims rather than defining their novelty.
